description.value: A Pacheedaht First Nation campground where two rivers meet the Pacific at Port Renfrew, with a full mile of rugged beachfront alongside forested and riverside pitches, open all year. Unserviced tent rates run $45–$54/night depending on season—premium pricing that reflects the exceptional west coast setting near Avatar Grove and Botanical Beach.

address.value: 305 Pachidah Rd, Port Renfrew, BC V0S 1K0

raw_osm.description: During off-season, registration and payment is at main campground in Pacheedaht village.
raw_osm.name: Pacheedaht Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate First Nations-operated campground open year-round near Port Renfrew, with an active online booking system and multiple site categories. OSM's drinking_water=no and internet_access=no tags are not contradicted by the website (serviced site 'water' hookups are utility connections for RVs, not confirmed potable); serviced sites do include electrical power, but no dedicated device-charging amenity is described for all campers. Two different addresses appear on the same website pages, flagged as a concern.
concerns: Two different addresses appear on the same website pages: '350 Kalaid Street, Port Renfrew, BC V0S 1K0' in the header contact section and '305 Pachidah Rd, Port Renfrew, BC V0S 1K0' in the footer — physical campground address is ambiguous; footer address used.

OSM tag drinking_water=no is uncontradicted by the website, but the website does not explicitly confirm the absence of communal potable water; 'water' in serviced site descriptions appears to refer to utility hookups rather than drinking water.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operated First Nations campground in a high-traffic cycling destination on southwest Vancouver Island; clear value for touring cyclists needing an overnight stop near Port Renfrew.

wow_evidence: Pacheedaht First Nation campground where two rivers meet the Pacific at Port Renfrew, with a full mile of rugged beachfront
